instruction: Change the font of the title text on the title slide to Arial

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the font of the title 'Minimalistic Newsletter' to Arial on slide 1.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core requirement: changing title text font to Arial
Getter logic is correct: postconfig saves file, get_vm_file retrieves the PPTX from VM
Metric logic is mostly sound: opens presentation, finds correct slide, searches for text, checks font name
Minor issue: metric uses substring matching (text_to_check in run.text) which could pass if only partial text has correct font
In practical cases where title is single run or consistently formatted, will work correctly
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider verifying that ALL runs containing the target text have the expected font, not just any run with a substring match
Alternative: verify the entire text frame has consistent font formatting before checking individual runs
